themes.name: Rugged Auto
themes.description: Bespoke rugged-archetype theme for independent used-car dealers with bold red signage, condensed display type, and strong stock presentation.

themes.name: Autowow Performance
themes.description: Bespoke rugged-archetype theme for Autowow UK Ltd — performance/dealer-floor signature with brand-tinted grid-overlay hero, dense filtered-sidebar inventory, and full-bleed mosaic detail page in a brutalist voice.

themes.name: Axis Autos — Minimalist
themes.description: Calm minimalist dealer with a left-anchored single hero photo against generous whitespace, hairline-borderless chrome, and sentence-case display titles in a formal voice.

themes.name: Buy4Less Vector
themes.description: Classic corporate dealer — white page with deep-navy full-width bands (utility topbar, vehicle-search band, value-props band, footer), royal-blue CTAs and bold uppercase Montserrat display type. Photo hero with two-line headline, navy search band with make/body/price selects, tabbed inventory showcase, four-point assurance band, finance/trade-in two-panel split and a top-brands strip. Fully token-driven so the dashboard recolours every surface.

themes.name: Cnhcars (clone)
themes.description: Page-for-page clone of carous-platform app `cnhcars`, tokenized for brand overrides.

themes.name: Dual Stock Modern
themes.description: Modern dual-stock theme for UK dealers selling cars AND motorbikes side by side — racing-red brand accent, dark dealer-signage typography, type-aware inventory contract with engine_size/body_type for bikes.

themes.name: FBM Motors
themes.description: Dual-tier dealer theme — light-dominant surfaces with dark anchor sections (hero, testimonials, footer), ember/orange brand accent, condensed display type, and full-photo section breaks. Ported page-for-page from the First Buy Motors source app and tokenized for brand overrides.

themes.name: Gilded Drive
themes.description: Futuristic showcase theme adapted for brand tokens.

themes.name: Prestige Dark
themes.description: Bespoke prestige theme with gold-on-black styling, appointment-led presentation, bold display wordmark and editorial dark-tier composition.

themes.name: Queensbury Cars
themes.description: Bespoke sport-modern theme for Queensbury Cars — cobalt-on-white with bold display typography, a live horizontal stock ticker hero band, and gradient sweeps threading through alternating sections.

themes.name: Redgate Lodge Motor Group
themes.description: Bespoke theme for Redgate Lodge Motor Group — warm-premium claret-and-ivory serif design with a numbered proof ledger and hospitality-toned aftercare storytelling.

themes.name: Showroom Shine
themes.description: Bespoke theme for independent dealers with bold motoring signage, deep crimson on white, and condensed-bold display type.

themes.name: Classic Teal
themes.description: Crisp teal-accented dealer theme suited to independents who want a clean, trustworthy look.

themes.name: Warwick Hall Cars
themes.description: Bespoke theme for Warwick Hall Cars Ltd — heritage family-run UK dealer with deep-indigo brand identity, Cormorant Garamond display + Karla body, warm team-photo hero treatment.
